_note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-06 on the N01 pilot: ONE voice for everything, model eleven_v3, one unbroken take, clean background (no bed). Swap only if the owner says so.

_providers.elevenlabs: default when an entry has no 'provider'. Needs voice_id (+ optional model, default eleven_v3). Keys: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY… in .env.
_providers.voicestudio: local open-source backend (tools/vs.py). Needs profile_id (from `python3 tools/vs.py voices` or `clone`), optional engine (default omnivoice: NON-COMMERCIAL weights; use cosyvoice / voxcpm2 / moss-tts-v15 for ads) and language. Needs the VoiceStudio app running (VOICESTUDIO_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:3900).
